title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SCHC Fragment::from_bytes compile error - dangling stack reference
description: In `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs`, `Fragment::from_bytes` at line 259 returns `Fragment` with `payload: &body[2..2 + content_len]` where `body` is a stack-local array. Rust rejects this at compile time with error E0515 'cannot return value referencing local variable body'. The code does not compile. Fix: `from_bytes` must write the recovered payload into a caller-provided buffer (restore the old signature with `out: &mut [u8]`) instead of returning a reference. The All-1 payload path at line 255 also needs correction - it currently uses raw wire `data` bytes instead of recovered (shifted) `body` bytes.
